# Release Notes

**Cause handling & delegation**
- Parked shared causes get one final diagnosis attempt on a new base head, then a single file_cause_ticket, not operator escalation (#3759).
- Delegation runs now record the ticket they worked, so DoD verdicts join to the delegated attempt (#3041).

**PR triage & change control**
- PR-state v2 carries per-check red facts; triage reads them from events before calling GitHub (#3682).
- classify_head_checks seam on the triage compute, with a hand-labelled 48-head corpus (#2988).
- node_handshake_policy_gate_effect reads branches and check-handshake runs, returning every gate decision (#3634).
- A scheduled job re-mints OCC companions that a sibling landing put into conflict (#2977).
- AC3–AC6 re-bound to S5 data and the S6 caller test per operator ruling (#3515).

**Gates & validators**
- First omnibase_core validators convert to canonical check-compute nodes with verdict-parity tests (#1889).
- URL Authority Gate AST pass: DSN reads, os.getenv, from-os imports, constant-held keys (#1821).
- New structural direct-model-call gate node and check-direct-model-call pre-commit hook (#1837).
- Three no-* validators no longer pass green after scanning zero files (#1394).
- The receipt gate rejects every skip token; the approvals registry is retired (#1953).
- The canonical_handler_shape classifier resolves an inherited handle() (#1796).

**Protocols & typing**
- ProtocolNodeProjectionEffect: a synchronous effect protocol for projection writes (#87).
- Dispatch protocols accept an optional delivery context (#310).
- The environment dependency convention is typed, with a real env_var field (#1583).
- Protocol-conformance test suite per Protocol, plus a portable baseline-path fix (#1234).
- Dead mypy overrides dropped; the navigation history reducer node is typed (#3155).

**CI**
- merge_group triggers removed from 22 non-required workflows (canary) (#1392).
- Seven duplicate jobs cut from omni-standards-compliance.yml (#1395).
- call-repo-evidence-gate workflow starts S5 shadow counting in omnibase_spi (#354).

**Performance & local tooling**
- Lazy package inits cut a 1 s import to 0.09 s of work (#1918).
- onex local init writes the runtime.lane document and sets config_source: local-home (#2965).
- work-ledger --source projection|local|auto adds the union fold and a local-tail fallback (#1805).

**Data reads**
- Latest-per-key snapshot reads key only on columns the relation actually carries (#3224).

**Model routing**
- A free glm-4.5-flash rung leads cheap_cloud, reachable only via tenant BYOK keys (#3141).

**Dependencies & release**
- Bump actions/cache to 6 (#245); onex_change_control in the actions group (#1119); omniclaude hardcoded-model-config workflow (#329).
- omnibase_core 0.47.17 changelog entry and tag; no version change (#1702).
